name: Chuck Berry

pageEyebrow.zh: 早期摇滚 · 吉他与词曲作者

whyMatters.en: Chuck Berry was a major American rock’n’roll songwriter and guitarist of the 1950s. After Maybellene (1955) he issued a run of lasting songs that joined blues, country, and R&B materials with narratives aimed at young listeners. In the 1960s the Beatles, the Rolling Stones and others kept playing his material, carrying those songs into a new rock repertoire.
whyMatters.zh: Chuck Berry 是 1950 年代美国摇滚乐的重要词曲作者和吉他手。1955 年《Maybellene》之后，他连续发行了一批影响深远的歌曲，把 blues、country 和 R&B 的音乐材料与面向年轻听众的叙事结合起来。1960 年代，The Beatles、The Rolling Stones 等乐队继续演奏他的作品，使 Berry 的歌曲进入新一代摇滚乐的曲目体系。

note.en: Chess breakthrough single. Reworked from the country song Ida Red; country guitar/melody material with an R&B beat; car-chase lyric.
note.zh: Berry 在 Chess 的突破性单曲。歌曲以《Ida Red》为音乐基础重新创作，融合 country 与 R&B，并以汽车追逐为主题。

note.en: Chess single. Young guitarist as protagonist; Berry’s guitar and Johnnie Johnson’s piano are central to the cut.
note.zh: Chess 单曲。歌曲以一名希望成为音乐家的年轻吉他手为主人公，Berry 的吉他与 Johnnie Johnson 的钢琴构成录音的重要部分。

interviewQuotes.text: Everything I wrote about wasn’t about me, but about the people listening.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Chuck Berry
interviewQuotes.source: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame materials on Berry

lyricQuotes: Hail, hail rock and roll / Deliver me from the days of old

shortBio.en: St. Louis singer, guitarist, and songwriter. From Maybellene (1955) through Johnny B. Goode (1958), a core Chess run of rock’n’roll singles.
shortBio.zh: 圣路易斯歌手、吉他手与词曲作者。自《Maybellene》（1955）到《Johnny B. Goode》（1958），形成一批关键的 Chess 摇滚单曲。

body.en:
In 1955 Berry released Maybellene with Chess Records and soon charted on US pop and R&B lists. Over the following years he issued Roll Over Beethoven, School Day, Rock and Roll Music, Sweet Little Sixteen, and Johnny B. Goode—among the most important songwriter-guitarist records of 1950s rock’n’roll.

Chess sessions were not one fixed band; Johnnie Johnson was a key long-term partner, with Willie Dixon, Fred Below and others on different dates.
body.zh:
1955 年，Berry 与 Chess Records 合作发行《Maybellene》，很快进入美国流行和 R&B 榜单。此后几年，他连续发行《Roll Over Beethoven》《School Day》《Rock and Roll Music》《Sweet Little Sixteen》和《Johnny B. Goode》等作品，成为 1950 年代摇滚乐最重要的创作者之一。

Chess 录音并非一支始终不变的固定乐队；Johnnie Johnson 是最重要的长期合作伙伴之一，Willie Dixon、Fred Below 等也出现在不同录音中。

body.en:
Berry’s importance is not guitar technique alone.

His songs often use concrete subjects—people, cars, school, dances, life on the road—and put young listeners’ daily experience into rock songs. Maybellene is a car chase; School Day is student life; Johnny B. Goode follows a country boy learning guitar and hoping to become a musician.

His guitar playing is part of how those songs work. Chess cuts usually avoid heavy arrangement and let guitar riffs, rhythm, and voice drive the track.
body.zh:
Berry 的重要性不只在于吉他演奏。

他的歌曲经常以具体人物、汽车、学校、舞会和巡演生活为题材，把当时年轻人的日常经验写进摇滚歌曲。《Maybellene》写汽车追逐，《School Day》写学生生活，《Johnny B. Goode》则以一个乡村少年学习弹吉他、希望成为音乐家的故事展开。

与此同时，他的吉他演奏成为这些歌曲的重要组成部分。Berry 的录音通常不依赖复杂编曲，而是让吉他 riff、节奏和人声共同推动歌曲。

body.en:
Maybellene (1955) was Berry’s breakthrough Chess single.

Its musical base came from the country song Ida Red; Berry reworked it with new lyrics. Chess issued it under the title Maybellene. The cut joins country guitar and melody material with an R&B beat.

The car-chase story reached No. 5 on Billboard’s pop singles chart and No. 1 on the R&B chart—his first major commercial success.
body.zh:
《Maybellene》（1955）是 Berry 在 Chess Records 发行的突破性单曲。

歌曲的音乐基础来自 country 歌曲《Ida Red》，Berry 将它重新编排，并加入新的歌词。Chess 发行时使用了《Maybellene》这个标题。录音把 country 的吉他和旋律材料与 R&B 的节奏结合起来。

歌曲以汽车追逐为主题，最终登上 Billboard 流行单曲榜第 5 名，并在 R&B 榜获得第 1 名，成为 Berry 第一首重要商业成功的作品。

alt.en: Chuck Berry, circa 1958 — era of Maybellene and Chess singles
alt.zh: Chuck Berry，约 1958——《Maybellene》与 Chess 单曲时期

body.en:
Johnny B. Goode (1958) is among Berry’s best-known songs.

It tells of a guitarist from rural Louisiana who hopes to become a musician through playing. The lyric puts guitar, stage, and upward ambition in one story.

The recording centers on Berry’s electric guitar and voice; Johnnie Johnson’s piano is also a key part of this early sound. Rock & Roll Hall of Fame materials note that Johnson and Berry’s Chess partnership helped shape rhythmic patterns later rock players used. The opening guitar figure is one familiar entry point to Berry—not the only or universal “standard” source for rock intros.
body.zh:
《Johnny B. Goode》（1958）是 Berry 最著名的歌曲之一。

歌曲讲述一个来自路易斯安那乡村地区的吉他手，希望凭借演奏成为音乐家的故事。歌词把吉他、舞台和向上流动的梦想放在同一个叙事中。

录音以 Berry 的电吉他和人声为核心，Johnnie Johnson 的钢琴也是这套早期声音的重要组成部分。Rock & Roll Hall of Fame 的资料指出，Johnson 与 Berry 在 Chess 的合作共同形成了影响后世摇滚乐的节奏型。开头的吉他乐句是认识 Berry 音乐的一种常见入口，不宜写成摇滚吉他前奏的唯一或普遍「标准」来源。

body.en:
Berry’s songs kept being played by a new generation of rock bands in the 1960s.

The Beatles, the Rolling Stones and other British acts recorded or performed his material. For them he offered more than cover repertoire: a mature rock song craft—clear guitar sections, direct rhythm, and lyrics about young people’s lives.

His catalog became one important source as 1960s British rock re-engaged American blues, R&B, and rock and roll.
body.zh:
Berry 的歌曲在 1960 年代被新一代摇滚乐队持续演奏。

The Beatles、The Rolling Stones 等英国乐队都录制或演出过他的作品。对这些乐队而言，Berry 提供的不只是几首可以翻唱的歌曲，也包括一种成熟的摇滚歌曲写法：明确的吉他段落、直接的节奏，以及以年轻人的生活为题材的歌词。

他的作品因此成为 1960 年代英国摇滚乐重新理解美国 blues、R&B 和 rock and roll 时的重要来源之一。

body.en:
Berry’s stage act was part of his public image.

One of the best-known moves is the duck walk, later a signature of his shows and documented in the 1959 Newport Jazz Festival film Jazz on a Summer’s Day.

His influence cannot be reduced to that move. For later players, the lasting part is the songs: guitar riffs, clear rhythm, concise form, and song shapes other bands can play directly.
body.zh:
Berry 的舞台表演也是其公众形象的一部分。

他最著名的动作之一是 duck walk。这个动作后来成为 Berry 演出的标志，并被 1959 年 Newport Jazz Festival 的纪录片《Jazz on a Summer's Day》记录下来。

但 Berry 的影响不能只归结为这个动作。对后来乐手而言，更持久的部分来自他的歌曲：吉他 riff、明确的节奏、简洁的结构，以及能够直接被其他乐队演奏的歌曲形式。

note.en: Rock song with a guitarist as protagonist. Opening guitar figure, clear rhythm, and narrative lyric are a common entry to Berry’s music.
note.zh: 以吉他手为主人公的摇滚歌曲。开头的吉他乐句、清晰的节奏型和叙事歌词，后来成为认识 Berry 音乐的一种典型入口。

note.en: Berry combined blues, country, and R&B with guitar, short narratives, and lyrics aimed at young listeners. Chess sides were later replayed by many rock musicians.
note.zh: Berry 把 blues、country 和 R&B 的元素结合起来，用吉他、短篇叙事和面向年轻听众的歌词建立了自己的写作方式。Chess 的一系列录音后来被许多摇滚乐手重新演奏。

note.en: Chess recordings were not one unchanging band; different dates used different players. Johnnie Johnson was a key long-term partner; session lists also name Willie Dixon, Fred Below and others on various cuts.
note.zh:
Berry 在 Chess 的录音并不是由一支始终不变的固定乐队完成。不同录音使用过不同的伴奏乐手。

Johnnie Johnson 是其中最重要的长期合作伙伴之一。Chess 相关唱片资料还列出了 Willie Dixon、Fred Below 等参与不同录音的乐手。
